description: Check that a result-cache key contains every input that changes the result, and nothing volatile — Given the inputs of a cached computation (each declared as influencing the output or not, optionally volatile) and the list of inputs the cache key is built from, finds influential inputs missing from the key (stale or wrong hits), volatile inputs inside it (the cache never hits), unknown-influence inputs left out, and, for private results, a missing tenant dimension (cross-tenant leak). value.description: Optional value, used only to compute the key digest.

volatile.description: Changes on every call (timestamp, request id, nonce).

keyParts.description: Names of the inputs the key is built from.

private.description: The result is per-tenant or per-user.

tenantInput.description: Name of the input that identifies the tenant or user; required in the key when private.

name: cache-key-check
